with 
  TOTAL_PV as
    (
      select fact.analytic_value as pv
      from radar_reporting_prod.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD fact,
           radar_reporting_prod.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE node
      where
        fact.business_date = '2025-06-25'
        and fact.business_date = node.business_date 
        AND fact.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = node.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID
        AND fact.ANALYTIC_TYPE = 'PV'
        AND fact.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = 'IP'
        AND node.hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
        AND node.node_level = 1
    ),
  WF_VW_CREDIT_EXPOSURE_MINI AS
    (SELECT DISTINCT    
        parent.party_name,
        parent.rtg_final,
        COALESCE(ref_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code) AS country,
        parent.gics_sector,
        parent.is_government,
        parent.is_provincial,
        pos.investment_department,
        SUM( COALESCE(FACT.credit_exposure, 0) ) OVER ( PARTITION BY PARENT.party_name, PARENT.rtg_final ) AS ce_by_party_by_rating,
        SUM( COALESCE(FACT.credit_exposure, 0) ) OVER ( PARTITION BY PARENT.party_name, pos.investment_department ) AS ce_by_party_by_dept,
        SUM( COALESCE(FACT.credit_exposure, 0) ) OVER ( PARTITION BY PARENT.party_name ) AS ce_by_party,
        CASE
          WHEN PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' AND upper( PARENT.party_name ) LIKE 'PROVINCE OF ONTARIO%' THEN pv * 0.1
          WHEN PARENT.is_government = 'Y' AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' AND PARENT.domicile_country_code IN ('US', 'CA')
              AND upper(PARENT.party_name) IN ('UNITED STATES OF AMERICA', 'CANADA') THEN 0  
          WHEN PARENT.rtg_final IS NULL THEN -1  
          when regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '^AAA[\+\-]?$' ) then pv * 0.1
          WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^AA[\+\-]?$' ) THEN pv * 0.075
          WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^A[\+\-]?$' ) THEN pv * 0.05
          WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^BBB[\+\-]?$' ) THEN pv * 0.03
          when regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '(^B{1,2}[\+\-]?$|C|D)' ) then pv * 0.025  
          else -2 
        end as limit
      from
        radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,
        radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
        radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos,
        total_pv,
        radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
      left join radar_reporting_prod.ref_country ref_country on parent.domicile_country_code = ref_country.alpha_2_code and ref_country.business_date = parent.business_date
      where
        fact.business_date = '2025-06-25'
        and fact.business_date = child.business_date
        and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
        and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
        AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
        AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
        AND FACT.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
    )
  SELECT
    party_name,
    coalesce( rtg_final, 'NR' ) as rtg_final,
    country,
    CASE
      WHEN gics_sector = 'Telecommunication Services' then 'Telecom Services'
      ELSE COALESCE(gics_sector, 'Unknown')
    END AS gics_sector,
    investment_department,
    ce_by_party / 1000000 AS credit_exposure,
    case
      when limit > 0 then limit / 1000000
      else 0
    end as limit,
    case
      when limit > 0 then round( ce_by_party / limit * 100, 1 )
      else 0
    END AS limit_util
  FROM
    (SELECT DISTINCT
        party_name,
        min(rtg_final) over (partition by party_name ORDER BY ce_by_party_by_rating DESC) AS rtg_final,
        country,
        gics_sector,
        is_government,
        is_provincial,
        MIN(investment_department) OVER (PARTITION BY party_name ORDER BY ce_by_party_by_rating DESC) AS investment_department,
        ce_by_party,
        min(limit) over (partition by party_name ORDER BY ce_by_party_by_rating DESC) AS limit
      FROM
        WF_VW_CREDIT_EXPOSURE_MINI
    )
    where limit > 0 AND round( ce_by_party / limit * 100, 1 ) > 100
  order by ce_by_party desc

        SUM( COALESCE(FACT.credit_exposure, 0) ) OVER ( PARTITION BY PARENT.party_name ) AS ce_by_party,
        CASE
          WHEN PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' AND upper( PARENT.party_name ) LIKE 'PROVINCE OF ONTARIO%' THEN pv * 0.1
          WHEN PARENT.is_government = 'Y' AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' AND PARENT.domicile_country_code IN ('US', 'CA')
              AND upper(PARENT.party_name) IN ('UNITED STATES OF AMERICA', 'CANADA') THEN 0  
          WHEN PARENT.rtg_final IS NULL THEN -1  
          when regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '^AAA[\+\-]?$' ) then pv * 0.1
          WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^AA[\+\-]?$' ) THEN pv * 0.075
          WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^A[\+\-]?$' ) THEN pv * 0.05
          WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^BBB[\+\-]?$' ) THEN pv * 0.03
          when regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '(^B{1,2}[\+\-]?$|C|D)' ) then pv * 0.025  
          else -2 
        end as limit
      from
        radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,
        radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
        radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos,
        total_pv,
        radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
      left join radar_reporting_prod.ref_country ref_country on parent.domicile_country_code = ref_country.alpha_2_code and ref_country.business_date = parent.business_date
      where
        fact.business_date = '2025-06-25'
        and fact.business_date = child.business_date
        and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
        and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
        AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
        AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
        AND FACT.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
    )
  SELECT
    party_name,
    coalesce( rtg_final, 'NR' ) as rtg_final,
    country,
    CASE
      WHEN gics_sector = 'Telecommunication Services' then 'Telecom Services'
      ELSE COALESCE(gics_sector, 'Unknown')
    END AS gics_sector,
    investment_department,
    ce_by_party / 1000000 AS credit_exposure,
    case
      when limit > 0 then limit / 1000000
      else 0
    end as limit,
    case
      when limit > 0 then round( ce_by_party / limit * 100, 1 )
      else 0
    END AS limit_util
  FROM
    (SELECT DISTINCT
        party_name,
        min(rtg_final) over (partition by party_name ORDER BY ce_by_party_by_rating DESC) AS rtg_final,
        country,
        gics_sector,
        is_government,
        is_provincial,
        MIN(investment_department) OVER (PARTITION BY party_name ORDER BY ce_by_party_by_rating DESC) AS investment_department,
        ce_by_party,
        min(limit) over (partition by party_name ORDER BY ce_by_party_by_rating DESC) AS limit
      FROM
        WF_VW_CREDIT_EXPOSURE_MINI
    )
    where limit > 0 AND round( ce_by_party / limit * 100, 1 ) > 100
  order by ce_by_party desc

WITH
earliest_business_date_of_given_month AS (
    SELECT MIN(business_date) AS business_date
    FROM market_dev.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
    WHERE rate_type_code = 'SR'
        AND MONTH(business_date) = MONTH(DATE('2025-06-26'))
        AND YEAR(business_date) = YEAR(DATE('2025-06-26'))
),
fx_rates_usd_to_cad AS (
    SELECT
        business_date business_date,
        (CASE WHEN (UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y') THEN (1 / mid_price) ELSE mid_price END) exchange_rate
    FROM
        market_dev.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
    WHERE from_currency = 'USD'
        AND to_currency = 'CAD'
        AND mid_price IS NOT NULL
        AND mid_price <> 0
        AND rate_type_code = 'SR'
),
fx_rates_usd_to_local AS (
    SELECT
        business_date business_date,
        from_currency from_currency,
        to_currency to_currency,
        (CASE WHEN (UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y') THEN (1 / mid_price) ELSE mid_price END) exchange_rate
    FROM
        market_dev.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
    WHERE from_currency = 'USD'
        AND mid_price IS NOT NULL
        AND mid_price <> 0
        AND rate_type_code = 'SR'
),
fx_rates_cad_to_local AS (
    SELECT
        usd_to_cl.business_date business_date,
        'CAD' from_currency,
        to_currency to_currency,
        ROUND((usd_to_cad.exchange_rate / usd_to_cl.exchange_rate), 8) exchange_rate
    FROM
        (fx_rates_usd_to_local usd_to_cl
        INNER JOIN fx_rates_usd_to_cad usd_to_cad ON (usd_to_cl.business_date = usd_to_cad.business_date))
    UNION
    SELECT
        business_date business_date,
        'CAD' from_currency,
        'USD' to_currency,
        exchange_rate exchange_rate
    FROM
        fx_rates_usd_to_cad usd_to_cad
)
SELECT
    business_date,
    from_currency,
    to_currency,
    exchange_rate
FROM fx_rates_cad_to_local
WHERE business_date = (SELECT business_date FROM earliest_business_date_of_given_month)

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 26
		AND hour between 02 and 03
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-26 02:13:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

WITH RankedSecurities AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM reference.scd_securities
    WHERE business_date = '2025-06-25'
)
select a.*, b.*, c.*, f.*, d.*, e.*, p.*
from
(
select 
  ss.model_portfolio_id as id_model_portfolio,
  ss.scd_holding_key_id as id_source_holding,
  null as id_enterprise_holding,
  ss.abor_security_name as security_name,
  ss.abor_security_number as security_no,
  ss.quotation_currency_code as currency,
  sec.abor_country_id as country_code,
  ss.abor_security_type_id as security_type_code,	   
  ss.abor_security_type_name as security_type_name,
  ss.security_group_id as security_group_code,	   
  ss.security_group_name,
  '48' as instrument_type_code,
  ss.abor_instrument_type as instrument_type_name,	   
  sec.country_of_exposure_code as exposure_country_code,
  sec.country_of_exposure_name as exposure_country_name,
  sec.currency_of_exposure_code as exposure_currency_code,
  sec.currency_of_exposure_name as exposure_currency_name,
  ss.balance_nominal_number as balance_nominal,	   
  ss.clean_price * ss.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as clean_price_pc,
  cast(ss.clean_price as DECIMAL(18,2)) as clean_price_qc,
  ss.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency as balance_cost_value_qc,
  ss.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency as balance_cost_value_pc,
  ss.balance_book_value_quotation_currency as balance_book_value_qc,
  ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as clean_value_qc,
  ss.clean_value_portfolio_currency as clean_value_pc
from holdings.scd_holdings_main ss
left join RankedSecurities sec 
    on ss.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
where ss.business_date = '2025-06-25'
and sec.rn = 1) as a

  select
    concat(CAST(h.account_id AS varchar), '00', lpad(CAST(h.security_identifier AS varchar), 4, '0')) id_instrument,

    (CASE WHEN trim(i.country_of_exposure) = '' THEN '' ELSE UPPER(i.country_of_exposure) END) country_of_exposure,
    i.currency_of_exposure,
    0 as deal_commitment_amt_base_cur,
    0 as deal_commitment_amt_local_cur,
    i.developed_or_emerging,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_itd_base, 0) distribution_itd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_itd_local, 0) distribution_itd_local_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_qtd_base, 0) distribution_qtd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_qtd_local, 0) distribution_qtd_local_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_ytd_base, 0) distribution_ytd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_ytd_local, 0) distribution_ytd_local_cur,
    0 as dpi_base_itd,
    0 as dpi_local_itd,
    (CASE WHEN trim(s.ownership_pct) = '' THEN '0.00 %' ELSE concat(CAST(CAST(CAST(s.ownership_pct AS decimal(38,12)) * 100 AS decimal(10,2)) AS varchar), ' %') END) equity_ownership_percentage,
    i.region geographic_focus,
    i.gics_sector industry_focus,
    '0.0000000 %' as irr_percentage_base_itd,
    '0.0000000 %' as irr_percentage_local_itd,
    null as key_investment_style,
    0 as multiple_base_currency_itd,
    0 as multiple_local_currency_itd,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_itd_base, 0) paid_in_capital_itd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_itd_local, 0) paid_in_capital_itd_local_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_qtd_base, 0) paid_in_capital_qtd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_qtd_local, 0) paid_in_capital_qtd_local_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_ytd_base, 0) paid_in_capital_ytd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_ytd_local, 0) paid_in_capital_ytd_local_cur,
    s.reporting_name,
    s.ir_classification primary_investment_category,
    null as secondary_investment_category,
    null as segmentation,
    0 as unfunded_commitment_amt_base_cur,
    0 as unfunded_commitment_amt_local_cur,
    null as vintage_year
  from holdings.ci_sentry_holdings h
  join reference.ci_sentry_security s on h.security_identifier = s.security_identifier and h.business_date BETWEEN s.start_date and s.end_date
  join reference.ci_sentry_issuer i on s.issuer_identifier = i.issuer_identifier and h.business_date BETWEEN i.start_date and i.end_date
  left join (
    select
      business_date,
      security_identifier,
      account_id,
      hierarchy_group,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' then amount_local else 0 end) as distributions_itd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' then amount_base else 0 end) as distributions_itd_base,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' then amount_local else 0 end) as paid_in_itd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' then amount_base else 0 end) as paid_in_itd_base,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('quarter', date(business_date)) then amount_local else 0 end) as distributions_qtd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('quarter', date(business_date)) then amount_base else 0 end) as distributions_qtd_base,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('quarter', date(business_date)) then amount_local else 0 end) as paid_in_qtd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('quarter', date(business_date)) then amount_base else 0 end) as paid_in_qtd_base,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('year', date(business_date)) then amount_local else 0 end) as distributions_ytd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('year', date(business_date)) then amount_base else 0 end) as distributions_ytd_base,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('year', date(business_date)) then amount_local else 0 end) as paid_in_ytd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('year', date(business_date)) then amount_base else 0 end) as paid_in_ytd_base
    from trades_deals.ci_sentry_cashflows_hierarchy
    where hierarchy_group = 'Paid-In Distributions'

      business_date,
      security_identifier,
      account_id,

  join reference.ci_sentry_security s on h.security_identifier = s.security_identifier and h.business_date BETWEEN s.start_date and s.end_date
  join reference.ci_sentry_issuer i on s.issuer_identifier = i.issuer_identifier and h.business_date BETWEEN i.start_date and i.end_date

      security_identifier,
      account_id,
      hierarchy_group,

      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' then amount_local else 0 end) as paid_in_itd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' then amount_base else 0 end) as paid_in_itd_base,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('quarter', date(business_date)) then amount_local else 0 end) as distributions_qtd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('quarter', date(business_date)) then amount_base else 0 end) as distributions_qtd_base,

-- Query # 17 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,

-- Query # 17 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code
    FROM latest_business_date b
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date

-- Query # 17 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code

-- Query # 17 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code

        eem_par_sec.cppib_sector_classification_name_1 parent_cppib_sector_classification_1_name_current,

        -- scd_par_sec.abor_instrument_type_id as "parent_instrument_type_name_current",
        eem_par_sec.abor_instrument_type_name parent_instrument_type_name_current,
        eem_par_sec.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name parent_currency_of_exposure_name_current,
        eem_par_sec.security_group_name parent_security_group_name_current,
        -- as a pair these securities do not align any more
        scd_par_sec.abor_security_type_id parent_security_type_code_current_PS_SCD, -- KEPT_ON_PURPOSE -- probably best to switch to an the enterprise type for horizontal checks
        eem_par_sec.security_type_id parent_security_type_code_current, -- does not seem to be well populated for EQTYSWAP or derivatives -- Forced to SCD - seems to be ok now
        lth.parent_security_type_name as parent_security_type_name_current, -- this seems to work fine -- KP identified it is NOT the same as SCD
        eem_par_sec.security_type_name as parent_security_type_name_current_PSEEM,
        -- enterprise_party.issuer_id not sure if that is scd_securities.abor_issuer_id/ issuer_code_current,
        -- we can't really rely on this unless we join thru holdings
        scd_par_sec.abor_issuer_id parent_issuer_code_current_PS_SCD,
        eem_issr.epm_bloomberg_company_id parent_issuer_code_current,
        -- [underlier sec fields]
        
        eem_und_sec.isin isin_current,
        eem_und_sec.cusip cusip_current,
        eem_und_sec.sedol sedol_current,
        eem_und_sec.abor_security_id security_id_current,
        eem_und_sec.cppib_sector_classification_name_1 cppib_sector_classification_1_name_current,
        eem_und_sec.cppib_sector_classification_level_type_1 cppib_sector_classification_1_level_type_current,
        eem_und_sec.cppib_sector_classification_name_2 cppib_sector_classification_2_name_current, -- extra to compare to gics
        eem_und_sec.cppib_sector_classification_name_3 cppib_sector_classification_3_name_current, -- extra to compare to gics
        mh.business_classification_level_2_name as gics_business_class_lev_2_name_current,  -- holdings!
        --mh.business_classification_level_3_name as gics_business_class_lev_3_name_current,  -- holdings!
        COALESCE(eem_und_sec.bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange, eem_und_sec.esm_ticker) bloomberg_code_current, -- fixed income does not have bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange
        eem_und_sec.esm_exchange_code exchange_code_current,
        eem_und_sec.esm_exchange_name exchange_name_current,
        eem_und_sec.esm_incorp_country_code incorporated_country_code_current,
        und_rcoi.country_name incorporated_country_name_current,
        lth.security_name as "security_name_current",
        lth.leg_no as "leg_no",
        lth.id_model_portfolio as "model_portfolio_code",
        lth.parent_security_name as "parent_security_name_current",
        lth.parent_security_number as "parent_security_no_current",
        lth.total_market_value_pc as "total_market_value_pc",
        lth.total_market_value_qc as "total_market_value_qc",
        lth.underlying_index_name as "underlying_index",
        lth.currency_of_exposure_code as "currency_of_exposure_code_current",
        lth.country_of_exposure_name as "country_of_exposure_name_current",
        lth.cppib_party_id as "cppib_entity_id_current",
        lth.cppib_sec_id as "cppib_security_id_current",
        lth.currency_of_exposure_name as "currency_of_exposure_name_current",
        lth.parent_cppib_sec_id as "parent_cppib_security_id_current",
        lth.parent_quoted_currency_name as "parent_quoted_currency_name",
        lth.pool_name as "pool_account_name",
        lth.security_type_name as "security_type_name_current",
        lth.total_market_value_pc * uacpp.unitized_percentage as "acpp_total_market_value_pc",
        lth.total_market_value_pc * ubcpp.unitized_percentage as "bcpp_total_market_value_pc",
        mh.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as "fx_rate_qc_pc",
        mh.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency as "balance_cost_value_pc_raw",
        mh.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency as "balance_cost_value_qc_raw",
        case when eem_par_sec.security_type_name in ('Normal Cash Bucket', 'Interim Cash Bucket') then mh.dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency else mh.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency end as balance_cost_value_pc,
case when eem_par_sec.security_type_name in ('Normal Cash Bucket', 'Interim Cash Bucket') then mh.dirty_value_total_quotation_currency else mh.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency end as balance_cost_value_qc,
        lth.balance_nominal as "balance_nominal_number",
        mh.clean_price as "clean_price_qc",
        mh.clean_value_portfolio_currency as "clean_value_pc",
        mh.clean_value_quotation_currency as "clean_value_qc",
        mh.fx_factor_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as "fx_factor_qc_pc",
        mp.model_portfolio_name as "model_portfolio_name",
        -- fix on 06/12
        eem_und_sec.abor_security_number as "security_no_current",
        --!!! scd_par_sec.abor_coupon_rate as "coupon_rate",
        eem_und_sec.esm_coupon_rate coupon_rate,
        --!!! scd_par_sec.abor_instrument_type_id as "instrument_type_name_current",
        -- abor_instrument_type_name for parent
        eem_und_sec.abor_instrument_type_name instrument_type_name_current,
        por.portfolio_group_id as "portfolio_group_code",
        eem_und_sec.security_group_name as "security_group_name_current",
        mh.clean_price * mh.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as "clean_price_pc",
        (mh.long_settlement_correction_value_portfolio_currency + mh.balance_expected_restitution_portfolio_currency + mh.next_dividend_portfolio_currency + mh.next_coupon_portfolio_currency + mh.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency) as "total_accrued_income_pc",
        (mh.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency + mh.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency + mh.next_dividend_quotation_currency + mh.next_coupon_quotation_currency + mh.accrued_interest_quotation_currency)  as "total_accrued_income_qc",
        mp.asset_class_mandate_code as "asset_class_mandate_code",
        mp.asset_class_mandate_name as "asset_class_mandate_name",
        --null as "holding_level",
        --!!! scd_par_sec.abor_security_id
        --underlying.bloomberg_unique_id as "underlying_bloomberg_ticker_1_current",
        --underlying.bb_global_id as "underlying_bloomberg_ticker_2_current",
        eem_und_sec.esm_ticker underlying_bloomberg_ticker_1_current,
        mh.abor_maturity_date as "maturity_date",
        lth.parent_holding_key,
        mp.investment_department_code,
        mp.investment_department_name,
        mp.investment_strategy_code,
        mp.investment_strategy_name,
        pif.investmentstructurelevel2 investment_structure_level_02,
        pif.investmentstructurelevel3 investment_structure_level_03,
        pif.investmentstructurelevel4 investment_structure_level_04,
        pif.investmentstructurelevel5 investment_structure_level_05,
        -- not needed
        scd_par_sec.abor_contract_size parent_contract_size, -- no other source
        lth.business_date,
        trs.last_transaction_date,
        trs.trs_maturity_date,
        lth.process source_system_name,
        lth.ultimate_process,
        lth.process,
        --!!!eem_und_sec.scd_issuer_id issuer_code_current,
        eem_issr.epm_bloomberg_company_id issuer_code_current,
        eem_issr.epm_party_name as issuer_name_current,
        eem_issr.incorp_country_code issuer_country_of_incorporation_code_current,
        eem_issr_ult_par.epm_party_name bloomberg_ultimate_parent_name_current,
        lth.holding_level,
        COALESCE(eem_und_sec.shares_outstanding_real, eem_und_sec.total_shares_out_multiple * 1000000) shares_outstanding,
        mh.scd_holding_key_id HLDKEY,
        scd_par_sec.abor_security_number PSCDKEY,
        eem_par_sec.enterprise_security_id PEEMKEY,
        eem_und_sec.enterprise_security_id UEEMKEY,
        eem_und_sec.enterprise_security_id underlier_enterprise_security_id,
        eem_par_sec.enterprise_security_id parent_enterprise_security_id,      
        NULL as "empty_col"
FROM
        --holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough lth
        holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough_extended lth
        left join holdings.scd_holdings_main mh on lth.parent_holding_key = mh.scd_holding_key_id and date(mh.business_date) = lth.business_date
        -- replace? left for contract size: this is best joined on the parent holding
        -- we need scd_securities for the sec type and contract size for now
        left join reference.scd_securities scd_par_sec on scd_par_sec.abor_security_number = mh.abor_security_number and date(scd_par_sec.business_date) = date(mh.business_date) 
        left join asset.enterprise_security eem_par_sec on eem_par_sec.enterprise_security_id = lth.parent_enterprise_security_id and eem_par_sec.business_date = date(lth.business_date)
        -- nonsense
        left join asset.enterprise_security eem_und_sec on eem_und_sec.enterprise_security_id = lth.enterprise_security_id and eem_und_sec.business_date = date(lth.business_date)
        -- should not need this
        --left join asset.asset_security_identifiers asi on cast(scd_par_sec.cppib_sec_id as int) = asi.cppib_sec_id and asi.business_date = date(lth.business_date)
        left join reference.scd_model_portfolio mp on mh.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id and date(mp.business_date) =date(mh.business_date)
        -- portfolio_id not available in ma_holding_lookthrough
        left join reference.scd_portfolio por on por.portfolio_id  = mh.portfolio_id and date(por.business_date)=date(mh.business_date)
        left join finance_accounting.scd_unitization uacpp on mp.pool_account_code = uacpp.unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code and uacpp.acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' and uacpp.business_date =  mp.business_date
        left join finance_accounting.scd_unitization ubcpp on mp.pool_account_code = ubcpp.unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code and ubcpp.acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' and ubcpp.business_date = mp.business_date
        left join performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif on lth.business_date = date(pif.business_date) and lth.id_model_portfolio = pif.model_portfolio and pif.investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
        left join (SELECT trs_g.id_instrument, trs_g.id_underlying_instrument, max(trs_g.trade_date) last_transaction_date,
                    max(trs_g.maturity_date) trs_maturity_date 
                    from trades_deals.trs_trades trs_g
                    where trs_g.business_date = date'2025-06-20'
                    group by trs_g.id_instrument, trs_g.id_underlying_instrument
                    UNION ALL 
                    SELECT trs_g.id_instrument, trs_g.id_underlying_instrument, max(trs_g.trade_date) last_transaction_date,
                    max(trs_g.maturity_date) trs_maturity_date 
                    from trades_deals.rtrs_trades trs_g
                    where trs_g.business_date = date'2025-06-20'
                    group by trs_g.id_instrument, trs_g.id_underlying_instrument
                    ) trs on lth.parent_security_number = trs.id_instrument and lth.cppib_sec_id = trs.id_underlying_instrument
-- par issuer
left join party.enterprise_party par_eem_issr on par_eem_issr.enterprise_party_id = eem_par_sec.enterprise_party_id and par_eem_issr.business_date = date(lth.business_date)
-- undelier issuer and underlier ultimate issuer
left join party.enterprise_party eem_issr on eem_issr.enterprise_party_id = lth.enterprise_party_id and eem_issr.business_date = date(lth.business_date)
left join party.enterprise_party eem_issr_ult_par on eem_issr_ult_par.enterprise_party_id = eem_issr.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id and eem_issr_ult_par.business_date = date(lth.business_date)
left join reference.reference_country_codes und_rcoi on und_rcoi.country_code = eem_und_sec.esm_incorp_country_code and und_rcoi.business_date = date(lth.business_date)
where lth.business_date = date'2025-06-20'
    -- filter synthetics

    and por.portfolio_group_id in('CPPIB GROUP','SUPPLEMENTARY','BCPP','ACPP')

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-22')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-22')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_infra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Infrastructure'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('MPINLCP1D')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_infra_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-06-22')

/* cppi::20021b2ec487c275daefb853816089fe0057804da8a08a1c7ba4c8db28707e65 */
WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-22')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-22')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_infra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Infrastructure'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('MPINLCP1D')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_infra_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date

						ORDER BY date

						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,

								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-25')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-25')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_re_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_re_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date

ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,

/* cppi::ad5e21b8872bc05772d53b584b5c1038f6ee7e66218999d1e08eff9eb1f96fdd */
with cte as
(
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SEDOL ORDER BY (CASE WHEN cppib_sec_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END), cppib_sec_id) AS rn
    FROM asset.asset_equity
    where business_date = date'2025-06-25'
)
select
    eq.business_date,
    'IR_EQ_Benchmark' as benchmark_name,
    eq.cell_name as category,
    null as id_cppib_index,
    'tfm_bp_eq_benchmark' as feed_name,

    cte.instrument_name as security_name,
    'Equity' as asset_type,
    cte.sedol as sedol,
    cte.cusip as cusip,
    cte.isin as isin,
    ms.type,
    ms.sub_type,
    eq.local_price as last_value_eod,
    eq.local_price as last_value_ndo,
    eq.benchmark_weight as weight_eod,
    eq.benchmark_weight as weight_ndo,
    p.party_name as issuer_name,
    cte.cppib_sec_id as id_cppib_security,
    cte.currency_code as iso_currency_eod,
    cte.country_code as country_domicile,
    cte.listing_country_code as country_listing,
    cte.region_code as region,
    ms.cppib_market_capitalization_size_code as market_capitalization_size_code,
    cte.country_code as country_reference_code_eod,
    eq.benchmark_weight as benchmark_constituent_weight,
    null as sub_component,
    sr.rating_value as security_rating,
    pr.rating_value as issuer_rating,
    null as developed_market_flag,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_code_1 as classification_code_1,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_name_1 as classification_code_1_description,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_code_2 as classification_code_2,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_name_2 as classification_code_2_description,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_code_3 as classification_code_3,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_name_3 as classification_code_3_description,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_code_4 as classification_code_4,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_name_4 as classification_code_4_description,
    null as alternate_listing,
    rc.country_name,
    null as market_capitalization_base_eod,
    cte.shares_outstanding_real as investable_shares_eod,
    cte.trade_currency_code as iso_currency_local,
    null as quality,
    null as maturity_bucket
from market.tfm_bp_eq_benchmark eq
left join cte
    on eq.business_date = cte.business_date and eq.sedol = cte.sedol and cte.rn = 1
left join asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications ms
    on cte.cppib_sec_id = ms.cppib_sec_id and eq.business_date = ms.business_date
left join asset.asset_security_ratings sr
    on cte.cppib_sec_id = sr.cppib_sec_id and eq.business_date = sr.business_date and sr.rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
left join asset.asset_security_party_relationship spr
    on cte.cppib_sec_id = spr.cppib_sec_id and cte.business_date = spr.business_date and spr.role = 'ISSUER'
left join party.party p
    on spr.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id and eq.business_date = p.business_date
left join party.party_ratings pr
    on spr.cppib_party_id = pr.cppib_party_id and eq.business_date = pr.business_date and pr.rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
left join reference.reference_country_codes rc 
    on rc.country_code = cte.country_code and eq.business_date = rc.business_date
where eq.business_date = date'2025-06-25'

select

where business_date = '2025-04-30'

and analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' and percent_confidence_level = 95 and run_id = 'MRP_BCPP'
) as var
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, node_name, node_level, analytic_value as "mean", run_id from
radar_reporting_uat.benchmark_analytic_mean 
where business_date = '2025-04-30' and analytic_type = 'MEAN_10YR'
) as b on var.run_id = b.run_id and b.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name   
and b.node_name = var.node_name and b.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and b.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
and b.node_level = var.node_level
left join

) as c on var.run_id = c.run_id and c.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name 
and c.node_name = var.node_name and c.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and c.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
and c.node_level = var.node_level
left join
(
select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, node_name, node_level, sum(total) as cs01, run_id
from (
